name: @cc/dsh-state-feed
description: Delivers the project state into the conversation: L1 once as the first model-visible message of a root session (digest, open tasks, plan, last snapshot) and L2 as one aggregated delta at a turn boundary only when the projection hash changed. Both name the count of each open status (open, active, review) and list the open task titles from state/views/board.md; the delta enters the step through the pre-step decision, so the harness logs it as user/message. A delegated worker and a workspace without state/ receive nothing.
